summary: Butler National Corp filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to disclose a $90,000 cash increase in annual compensation for Executive Chairman Jeffrey D. Yowell, raising it to $340,000 effective June 1, 2026. The Compensation Committee approved the change; Mr. Yowell recused himself from discussion and voting. This is a routine executive compensation adjustment, not a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate event is involved. The filing is a standard current report on an ordinary business matter.
